name: Dutch Touch Genetics | Lilac Diesel
description:
3rd Place Sativa (High Times Cannabis Cup). Big buds have a complex terpene profile, including notes of citrus, sweet berries, earthy pine, and chem. Lilac Diesel is a great afternoon strain for a lackadaisical adventure.

Type: Sativa

Lineage: Silver Lemon Haze x Forbidden Fruit x NYC Cherry Pie x Citral Glue
